title: Texas Nightingale and Illinois Songbird nicknames
summary: She explains how newspapers and Okeh gave her the names Texas Nightingale and Illinois Songbird.

story.theme_name: How I got my name: nicknames and band monikers
story.community_name: How I got my name: nicknames and band names

blocks.x: Who called you the Texas Nightingale?
Some other paper (unintelligible). They say, I didn't come from Chicago, I came from Texas. (Unintelligible). And Texas say I come from Texas (unintelligible).
Is that where they called you the Texas Nightingale? In the Chicago "Defender"?
See, (inaudible) in Chicago. They think (unintelligible) I was born in Texas. Everybody wanted to call me the Illinois Songbird.
That's when they called you the Texas Songbird, in the newspaper?
In the newspaper, is that where they called you --
O.K. Gave her the handle of the Texas Nightingale (inaudible).
O.K. called you the Texas Nightingale? Was it O.K.?
Did you like that, that they called you the Texas Nightingale?
We might get so drunk we'll have a baby.
